combine: mean of a slot over years a…b = (S[b] − S[a−1]) / (N[b] − N[a−1]) (S[a−1], N[a−1] = 0 when a is the first year); a year e left out subtracts (S[e] − S[e−1]) and (N[e] − N[e−1]); N = 0 → no value (NaN)
layout: sum_pSS.npy [channel, year, lat, lon] float32 in PHYSICAL units, count_pSS.npy the same shape uint8, both CUMULATIVE over the years: plane (c, y) = every bin of slot SS in years year_first … year_first + y. Plane offset = header_len + (c * n_years + y) * H * W * itemsize; row 0 is the SOUTHERNMOST latitude (lat0), column 0 is lon0.
slot_rule: slot = min(72, floor((day_of_year(bin start, UTC) − 1) / 5)); bin b starts on 1982-01-01 + 5·b days; slot s holds the bins starting on days 5s+1 … 5s+5 of their year, slot 72 those starting on days 361 … 366; a bin belongs to the year of its start
time_rule: the tab's time value of slot s is 2000-01-01 + 5·s days (a nominal leap year); a slot is filed under the month of that day
